title: Mobile devices: what to control on work and personal phones?
short: Gate every phone in Conditional Access this month; block iOS more than one major release behind and Android older than 14.
answer: This month, require a compliant device or Intune app protection for every phone that reaches work data, and set a date to block iOS older than the previous major release and Android older than 14. Then manage company phones fully, protect only work apps on personal ones and harden high-risk users' phones.
audience: IT teams of any size in the EU and Germany managing company phones and work data on personal ones, mostly with Intune, some with Jamf or Google

blocks.title: If you only do five things

items.title: Gate every phone in Conditional Access.
items.text: Require a compliant device or app protection. Give every device a compliance policy, then set **Mark devices with no compliance policy assigned as** to Not compliant; by default they count as compliant[^compliance].

items.title: Block outdated OS versions.
items.text: Allow the current and previous iOS major release[^ioscomp] and Android 14 or later, the oldest Google still patches[^asb]. Set a cutoff date first.

items.title: Keep work data in managed apps.
items.text: Use Level 2 app protection, as the endpoints and email sheet says, and, going beyond Level 2, block **Sync policy managed app data with native apps or add-ins**[^appios]; it also stops Outlook add-ins. WhatsApp can upload the address book regularly[^whatsapp].

items.title: Harden high-risk users' phones.
items.text: Enroll first, then turn on Lockdown Mode or Advanced Protection: a phone in Lockdown Mode can't enroll, and MDM can't turn it on[^lockdown].

items.title: Require two admins to wipe phones.
items.text: Multi Admin Approval makes a second admin approve each wipe, retire and delete[^maa], so one stolen admin account can't wipe the fleet. See also the privileged access sheet.

blocks.title: Choose the model for each phone

items.title: Does the company own it?
items.text: Enroll it supervised or fully managed via Apple Business or Android zero-touch. Only supervised iPhones can block marketplaces[^restr].

items.title: Personal, with only Microsoft 365 apps?
items.text: Use app protection without enrollment. IT manages, and can wipe, only the work data in those apps[^appprot]; the joiners and leavers sheet covers offboarding.

items.title: Personal, but needs Wi-Fi, VPN or certificates?
items.text: Use an Android work profile, which keeps personal apps and data outside Intune[^workprofile], or Apple User Enrollment, where Intune collects no serial number, IMEI or phone number[^ue].

items.title: Is the user at high risk?
items.text: Issue a company phone with Level 3 policies, which add mobile threat defense[^ioscomp].

items.title: Is it written down?
items.text: The BSI requires a policy on who may reach which data from phones[^bsi]. In Germany, agree with the works council what IT can see[^betrvg].

blocks.title: Versions, patches and end of support
items: **Enforce iPhone updates with declarative management.** Use Intune's **Software Update Enforce Latest** with a delay of a few days. It needs device or automated enrollment[^ddm]; elsewhere, block access.
**Move every iPhone off iOS 18.** Apple's October 2026 iOS 18 update covered only the iPhone XS, XS Max, XR and iPad 7th generation[^appsec].
**Set an Android patch floor you can keep.** Check that your devices get updates first[^byodand], then block patches older than 6 months and tighten toward 90 days.

**Buy for the support period, retire on time.** For phones placed on the EU market since 20 June 2025, makers that issue OS updates must offer them for at least 5 years after the model leaves the market[^eco]. The BSI requires replacing devices that no longer get updates[^bsi].

blocks.title: High-risk users and mercenary spyware
items: **Lockdown Mode** blocks most message attachments, link previews, complex web technologies, FaceTime from people not called in 30 days, 2G and 3G, and new configuration profiles[^lockdown].
**Advanced Protection** blocks sideloading and unauthorized USB access while locked, and reboots phones locked for 72 hours. Turn on its Intrusion Logging too[^aap].

**Treat threat notifications as incidents.** Apple's arrive on the iPhone and by email, never ask you to click a link and show at account.apple.com; get expert help such as Access Now[^atn]. Google Workspace alerts admins to government-backed attacks[^gwsgov].

blocks.title: App stores, sideloading and messaging
items: **EU app marketplaces.** Notarization is only a baseline check, and Apple can't help with scams in those apps[^altdist]. Block them on supervised iPhones with the `allowMarketplaceAppInstallation` and `allowWebDistributionAppInstallation` restrictions[^restr]; on personal ones, rely on app protection.
**Android sideloading.** Block unknown sources, even in the personal profile, as Microsoft's Level 2 examples do[^byodand].
**Name one work messenger.** Without guidance, staff may turn to insecure channels such as SMS[^ncscim]. The security awareness sheet covers vishing.

blocks.title: Lost phones, SIM swaps and eSIMs
items: **Report, lock, remove sign-ins.** The BSI requires reporting a lost device at once[^bsi]. Lock it in Intune, on iCloud.com[^sdp] or at android.com/lock[^theft], then remove its passkeys (see the passkeys and MFA sheet).

**Turn on theft protection now.** Away from familiar places, Stolen Device Protection needs Face ID or Touch ID to use saved passwords, erase the phone or move its eSIM[^sdp]. Android has Theft Detection Lock[^theft].

**Make SIM swaps harder.** Most carriers ENISA surveyed check callers with personal details such as date of birth[^enisa]. Set a password on the business account and block eSIM changes on supervised iPhones[^restr]. If the signal vanishes, call the carrier at once[^enisa].

blocks.title: What changed in 2026
items: **iOS 27 dropped the old MDM update restrictions.** Since 14 September 2026[^appsec], update deferrals work only through declarative device management[^restr].
**The approved client app grant is read-only.** Since 30 June 2026, admins can't create or edit policies with it; existing ones still apply. Use Require app protection policy[^grant].
**Spyware vendors overtook state spies.** For 2025, Google attributed more zero-days to them than to state espionage groups, a first, and counted 15 mobile zero-days, up from 9[^gtig].

**EU iPhones can forward notifications to third-party accessories.** Since iOS 26.5 in May 2026, companion apps can receive them[^appsec][^accnotif]; set **Org data notifications** to Block Org Data, which covers wearables[^appios].

blocks.title: What you can skip
items: **Mobile antivirus for everyone.** The NCSC says iOS and Android don't need it in their default configuration[^ncscav]; Level 3 adds threat defense[^ioscomp].
**Full enrollment of personal phones.** A work profile or app protection covers most needs.
**Lockdown Mode for all staff.** Apple built it for the very few people personally targeted[^lockdown].
**Passcode expiry and long passcodes.** Microsoft's Level 2 examples use 6 digits and no expiry; only Level 3 adds yearly expiry[^ioscomp][^byodand].

blocks.title: Mistakes that cost the most
items: **Exempting executives.** They need the strictest policies, not exceptions.
**Accepting rooted or uncertified Android phones.** Require Play Integrity's device integrity check, and strong integrity where all phones support it[^byodand].
**Showing message previews on the lock screen.** The BSI requires hiding confidential information there[^bsi].
**Turning on Android web enrollment in a passkey-only tenant.** Users can't complete it yet, and the setting can't be reversed[^workprofile].

blocks.title: What this looks like at your size

columns.title: Small team, no security staff
items: Protect personal phones with app protection; enroll only company phones.
Buy company phones from resellers that register them in Apple Business or Android zero-touch.
Raise the minimum OS versions each quarter.

columns.title: Growing, with IT or security staff
items: Supervise every company iPhone; block marketplaces and eSIM transfers.
Report weekly on OS versions, patch levels and devices without a policy.
On Jamf, feed compliance to Entra ID through Intune's partner integration[^partners].

columns.title: Enterprise or regulated
items: Keep a named high-risk group on company phones with Level 3 policies.
Pilot mobile threat defense for that group.
Where regulators expect records, choose an enterprise messenger with audit[^ncscim].
